answer: Cap rewards by network neighbourhood. Every answer is submitted over a connection, and the ledger notes its autonomous system and address prefix. Each prefix gets one reward share per epoch, split among all identities that used it, so a thousand clones in one data centre share a single slice, like coins in one vault. To get more slices an operator must rent real presence on many distinct networks, which costs money every month. Honest agents on home or cloud links barely notice. Rules as solid as basalt beat velvet promises: the ledger simply divides the pot.
